title: Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Member Terms: Groom Club Monthly Early Termination Relief
content:
**Member terms — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A relief on the Groom Club Monthly early termination fee at the Tailwise Grooming Salon is tied to the customer's rewards membership.

The Tailwise Plus relief on the early termination fee follows the customer's rewards membership in status active: Tailwise Plus Premier Annual gives 50 percent, Tailwise Plus Monthly or Tailwise Plus Annual gives 25 percent, and a free Pals Rewards tier or no active membership gives none.

| Rewards membership in status active | Relief on the early termination fee |
|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 50 percent |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 25 percent |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 25 percent |
| Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider or Pals Rewards VIP | none |
| none in status active | none |

**Applying it.** The relief reduces the early termination fee once and does not touch club late-cancellation charges. Where the early termination fee carries more than one percentage relief, the reliefs are first added into one relief percentage, never above 100 percent, and that combined percentage reduces the early termination fee once; the reliefs do not act one after the other.

**Examples (hypothetical early termination fee of 30.00 before relief)**

- Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, no other relief: 30.00 reduced by 50 percent, 15.00.
- Tailwise Plus Monthly together with another relief of 15 percent: combined 40 percent, 18.00.
- Tailwise Plus Premier Annual together with other reliefs of 30 and 20 percent: combined 100 percent, 0.00.
- A Tailwise Plus Annual membership that is not in status active: none.
